text:
Been to the clinic for an emergency health case. The doctor was very patient and professional and the assistants were so much helpful. The medical fees including the checkup, injection and pills for over a week was only 400THB which is very convenient.
I strongly recommend this clinic to have a lookup at the clinic if you have something like a mild fever or anything else. Hospitality=150%✅
